content:
Imagine you're driving home after a long day.

A Slack message comes in.

Then you remember there's a PR waiting for review.

CI might be failing.

And suddenly, you're mentally back at your desk.

But what if you could just say:

"Hey Siri, Jarvis. What are my open PRs?"

That's exactly what carcode is built for.

It brings Claude Code into your car through Siri + Apple CarPlay.

No new app.
No API key.
No complicated dashboard.

Just your voice.

You can ask it to:
→ Check your open PRs
→ Tell you whether CI is green
→ Catch you up on Slack or email
→ Review a PR
→ Check your calendar
→ Fix a small issue and create a draft PR

And the interesting part?

It doesn't blindly execute actions.

If you ask it to send a message, approve a PR, merge code, or post something publicly, it reads the action back and waits for your "confirm"

That makes the idea much more practical for real-world use.

Under the hood, your words travel from your car to your Mac, where your normal Claude Code session does the work with your existing GitHub, Git, Slack, Calendar and other tools.

Everything is open source and MIT licensed.

And you can even try it without a car using:

I love products that don't try to replace your workflow.

carcode is live today on Product Hunt:
https://lnkd.in/gtqzpppB

They simply make the workflow available when you're away from your desk.

Would you actually use Claude Code from your car? 🚗

Founder Harsh Rastogi
